status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY OUTCOME. No arm has been trained.
question: Can we improve humanoid control by spending more training on difficult but learnable physical conditions, while preserving performance on conditions already learned?
why_this_comes_first: Every curriculum result so far answers whether the training ranges move, not whether moving them helps. Before building any scheduler, this screen asks where extra practice is productive at all. It is exploratory: it guides the design and does not replace a from-scratch comparison.

design.type: matched continuation branches from one origin, single seed screen
design.origin: fixed@s8600 final checkpoint (the lambda=1 envelope already solved)
design.the_only_difference: what a fixed 25% share of the same 1024 environments practises
design.reallocation_not_addition: the practice share is taken out of the lambda=1 cohort. A targeted arm trains on FEWER standard-mixture episodes, never on more episodes, so no arm receives extra training.
design.probe_gradients: there are no probes in this screen. The practice stratum is a training cohort and its episodes contribute to PPO updates like every other environment. Its simulation and training cost is counted in the shared budget.
design.retained_practice_is_fresh_rollouts: the retained stratum draws fresh episodes at its own parameters every reset; nothing replays stored trajectories.

arms.fixed: the plain control: one stratum, all 1024 envs at lambda 1. Answers how much comes from simply continuing to train.
arms.prac_null: the matched control: two strata, 768/256, both at lambda 1. Dispatcher active, content identical. Every treatment effect is measured against THIS arm.
arms.prac_easy: placebo: 256 envs practise mass 3x, CoM 3x, joint 3x -- the channels the sweep found nearly free.
arms.prac_push: bottleneck: 256 envs practise push 3x -- the binding channel.
arms.prac_pushfric: both factors at the SAME levels the single-factor arms use, so the interaction is estimable
arms.prac_fric: the second factor alone: 256 envs practise friction at 1.5x

levels_are_measured_not_chosen.rule: the bottleneck level is the measured one that is clearly failing and clearly off the floor (push 3x at 0.746); the placebo levels are the measured ones that are already manageable (>= 0.949).

evaluation.also_scored: the origin checkpoint itself, so improvement is measured against the starting point as well as against the control
evaluation.exposure_labelling: each cell is labelled in-support or held-out per arm from the arm's realized per-stratum vectors in its own TACE telemetry. An in-support cell may never be used to claim generalization.
evaluation.unseen_values_vs_unseen_draws: cells above an arm's practised level test unseen parameter VALUES; cells at or below it test unseen DRAWS inside a familiar range. The two are reported separately and never pooled.

margins.basis: paired single-cell noise at 512 episodes is 2-3 points (channel attribution caveats); the between-seed effect on absolute capability reaches 7.8 points, which is why one seed screens and does not decide.

decision_rules_frozen_before_outcomes.R1_is_the_bottleneck_learnable: prac_push minus prac_null at ch_push_300 >= +5.0 pts means push failure is a practice deficit and targeted practice repairs it. |delta| < 2.0 means it is NOT a practice deficit at this budget: no allocation scheduler can fix push by exposure, and the range-expansion direction loses its main justification.
decision_rules_frozen_before_outcomes.R2_does_targeting_matter: prac_push minus prac_easy on the broad-suite macro average >= +5.0 pts means where you practise matters. A tie or a loss means extra exposure helps wherever it is aimed and the channel-selection machinery is unnecessary.
decision_rules_frozen_before_outcomes.R3_do_combinations_need_their_own_practi: R3a: prac_pushfric minus prac_push at ch_push_fric_350_150 >= +5.0 pts means adding friction practice to push practice buys something. R3b (the interaction): (pushfric - null) - [(push - null) + (fric - null)] at the same cell >= +5.0 pts means the pair is super-additive, which is what a joint-corner component would be for. Additive within the margin means that component has nothing to add here.
decision_rules_frozen_before_outcomes.R4_no_hidden_trade_off: any arm that gains on its target while losing more than 2.0 pts against prac_null at phys_000 or phys_100 is reported as a trade-off, not an improvement.
decision_rules_frozen_before_outcomes.R5_more_training_alone: prac_null minus the origin on the broad suite is the effect of continuing to train. Every treatment effect is reported against prac_null, never against the origin.
decision_rules_frozen_before_outcomes.R6_generalization_beyond_the_practised_r: an arm claims generalization only from cells above its own practised level (ch_push_350, ch_push_fric_300_150).
decision_rules_frozen_before_outcomes.R7_negative_results_are_the_result: a screen in which no targeted arm beats prac_null is reported as such and ends the allocation direction. It is not repeated with different levels in search of a positive.

what_this_screen_cannot_decide: one seed ranks designs and does not decide; a positive direction must be confirmed on new seeds
it does not compare against a preset expansion schedule or against fixed randomization over the wider target range; those are the next hurdle and are specified separately
it warm-starts from a solved lambda=1 policy, so it says where practice helps a competent policy, not how to train one from scratch

comparators: fixed randomization over the wider target range
a preset expansion schedule to the same final ranges
a preset PER-PARAMETER schedule with the same practice mixture
next_hurdle_if_positive.rule: a preset schedule is constructed from the screen runs and FROZEN before the confirmation seeds are trained; a schedule may never be derived from the run it is compared against
next_hurdle_if_positive.matching: matched total resources including any probes, with realized exposure reported per arm
next_hurdle_if_positive.claim: beating only the narrower fixed baseline does not establish the value of adaptation

primary_outcome: per-cell success on the frozen suite after an equal total budget, reported as paired differences against prac_null with the exposure label attached to every cell

implementation.curriculum: gear_sonic/research/practice_utility/dr_curriculum.py, practice_vectors_json: an explicit per-stratum vector of channel intensities, parsed once, never moved during a run, with no signal input and no path that can contract anything

amendments.trigger: advisor review 2026-09-03: give each claimed mechanism a comparison that could show it is unnecessary, and check the readout's missing-data behaviour

A1_interaction_is_now_estimable.was: prac_pushfric practised push at 2.0 while prac_push practised it at 3.0, so their difference mixed 'add friction' with 'lower the push dose' and compared recipes
A1_interaction_is_now_estimable.now: prac_pushfric practises push at 3.0 (the same level as prac_push) and friction at 1.5 (the same level as the new prac_fric arm). {null, push, fric, pushfric} is a 2x2 on {push practice, friction practice}
A1_interaction_is_now_estimable.new_cell: ch_push_fric_350_150, above the corner the combination arm practises, so it stays held out for it
A1_interaction_is_now_estimable.cost: one extra arm, about 1 GPU-h; total about 6.6

A2_a_negative_result_is_bounded.rule: R1 and R2 negatives reject THIS allocation at THIS origin, budget and dose. They do not establish that any scheduler, any dose, or any origin would fail, and the readout and the paper must say so.
A2_a_negative_result_is_bounded.why: the screen fixes the practised level, the share, the budget and the starting policy; each is a parameter of the result, not a property of allocation in general

A3_readout_missing_data_rules.macro_denominator: macro averages are taken only over cells present for EVERY compared branch; branches missing a cell are listed and the denominator is reported, so a branch cannot look better by missing its hardest cell
A3_readout_missing_data_rules.unknown_exposure: a branch whose realized exposure was not recorded gets support 'unknown' for every widened cell, never 'held out'; those cells are excluded from generalization claims on both sides

A4_equivalence_language.rule: a preregistered tolerance rule passing is a decision, not a demonstration of equivalence. Wherever this screen reports 'within margin', it also reports the one-sided interval and says whether it lies inside the margin.
A4_equivalence_language.worked_example: the three-seed never-shrink comparison passes its rule with mean +0.60 pts, and its one-sided 95% lower bound is -3.19 pts, outside the 2-point margin
